title: An ALMA Imaging Study of Methyl Formate (HCOOCH<SUB>3</SUB>) in Torsionally Excited States toward Orion KL
question: Do rotational and vibrational (torsional) temperatures of methyl formate differ in Orion KL Compact Ridge and Hot Core when resolved with ALMA, unlike the earlier single-dish result?

what.value: Rest frequencies of v_t=0,1 (lab data set)

evidence.quote: The data set is from (cite: ily09) which includes the data by (cite: bro75), (cite: bau79)
The rest frequencies in $v_{t}$=2 were taken from (cite: mae08) and (cite: kob13).
$\Delta E$=132 cm$^{-1}$ (cite: tud12) and $\Delta E$=250 cm$^{-1}$ (cite: sen05) were assumed for $v_{t}=$1 and 2, respectively
The A sublevel rotational constants given by (cite: bau79) were used to calculate Equation (1).

recipe.method: CASA imaging with Hogbom clean, natural weighting; linear continuum fit to line-free channels

recipe.goal: Identify methyl formate lines and check blending
recipe.method: Match to lab rest frequencies; check overlap using Splatalogue; classify B/NB/ND
key_parameters: NB if contaminant weaker than ~10% of methyl formate line

recipe.goal: Map distributions and extract line parameters
recipe.method: Integrated intensity maps 4-12 km/s; Gaussian fits to spectra of Compact Ridge and Hot Core giving T, FWHM, VLSR, W
Q = Q_rot Q_tor with analytic Q_rot and sum over torsional states up to v_t=2
assumptions: Same torsional energies for A and E sublevels

recipe.goal: Rotation diagrams: temperatures and column densities
recipe.method: Rotation diagrams per component, per torsional state (T_rot) and all states combined (T_eff = T_vib); LTE; optically thick lines excluded
assumptions: LTE, optically thin after exclusion; tau~2 at Smu2~35 assuming 150 K

answer_key.quantity: Effective temperature, Compact Ridge, 7.3 km/s component
Rotational temperature v_t=0, Compact Ridge 7.3 km/s
Number of methyl formate transitions found in v_t=0,1,2

evidence.quote: Briefly, 84, 68, and 62 transitions were found to be due to the transitions of methyl formate in $v_{t} =$0, 1 and 2, respectively.

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and calibration (SV data products used?) details
Line-free channel ranges and continuum fit per setting
Clean mask, image size, cell size, number of iterations/threshold
Spectrum extraction aperture (green circle size) for Compact Ridge and Hot Core
Gaussian fitting procedure and uncertainty derivation for line parameters
Rotation diagram fitting method (weights, treatment of errors, beam filling)
Source distance/column density equation details and whether continuum was corrected for optical depth
missing_for_reproduction: Fitting method details for rotation diagrams
score_reason: Public data and line tables given, but imaging and fitting details sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, line tables with measured values, and numeric temperatures/column densities; recipe moderately complete.
